entities.summary: Clifford Bundy Stearns Sr. is an American businessman and politician who was the U.S. representative for Florida's 6th congressional district from 1989 to 2013. He is a member of the Republican Party. Cliff Stearns was a performers & entertainers from Washington, D.C. (b. 1941-04-16, Washington, D.C.). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
